recommended_approach: Use a Rigid Body World workflow for the shatter event: keep all simulated pieces and constraints in the Rigid Body World collections, increase simulation accuracy for the high-speed impact (Substeps Per Frame + Solver Iterations), and bake/cache the sim for frames 1-60 before rendering frame 12. This is the strongest documented path returned for a violent collision-style event.

key_parameters.rigid_body_world.collection: Required: only objects in the Rigid Body World Collection are simulated.
key_parameters.rigid_body_world.constraints_collection: Required: only constraints in the assigned Constraints collection are evaluated.
key_parameters.rigid_body_world.speed: Time scale control (higher=faster sim, lower=slower sim).
key_parameters.rigid_body_world.split_impulse: Use when collision adds extra velocity artifacts; docs note possible stability tradeoff.
key_parameters.rigid_body_world.substeps_per_frame: Increase for better high-speed collision accuracy.
key_parameters.rigid_body_world.solver_iterations: Increase for more stable/accurate collision and constraints.
key_parameters.cache.bake_mode_note: Bake from Object Mode; bake to lock results before render.
